verdict.rationale: pnpm's install command bootstraps a declared project from one entry point. It works on existing projects with no migration and installs a whole monorepo from a single lockfile. It switches to the pinned package-manager version from `packageManager`/`devEngines.packageManager` and fetches the declared Node.js runtime via `devEngines.runtime`. In CI it uses frozen-lockfile mode for reproducibility, and community users report fast, smooth installs after migrating. Missing for 10: no doc excerpt explicitly describing a plain `pnpm install` installing everything from a fresh clone; dependency build scripts require separate approval, so a fresh install may not fully build every package without extra configuration.
